name: Exp_ASCtrend
summary: This EA trades based on the ASCtrend custom indicator signals, opening buy positions on up signals and sell positions on down signals. It supports configurable money management modes, stop loss/take profit, and optional position closing on opposite signals. The strategy processes signals on new bars and includes a historical scan for close signals when both open and close permissions are enabled.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ASCtrend自定义指标信号进行交易，在上行信号时开多仓，在下行信号时开空仓。支持可配置的资金管理模式、止损/止盈，以及在反向信号时可选的平仓功能。策略在新K线形成时处理信号，并在同时允许开仓和平仓时扫描历史数据寻找平仓信号。
strategy_analysis: 该EA使用ASCtrend指标作为核心信号源，该指标基于RISK参数计算趋势方向并在关键转折点产生上下信号。入场条件为：当ASCtrend指标的上行信号缓冲区（buffer 1）在指定信号K线上产生非零且非空值时开多仓，当下行信号缓冲区（buffer 0）产生有效值时开空仓。出场条件包括止损和止盈硬编码参数，以及当启用反向平仓时，扫描历史K线寻找反向信号进行平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制交易量比例，并支持五种资金管理模式：自由保证金比例、余额比例、扣除亏损后的自由保证金比例、扣除亏损后的余额比例以及固定手数。EA使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只处理一次信号，避免重复入场，同时通过Recount标志在数据获取失败时进行重试。信号时间戳被记录用于交易执行的时间参考。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the ASCtrend indicator as its core signal source, which calculates trend direction based on the RISK parameter and generates up/down signals at key turning points. Entry conditions: a buy position is opened when the ASCtrend indicator's up signal buffer (buffer 1) produces a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE on the specified signal bar, and a sell position is opened when the down signal buffer (buffer 0) produces a valid value. Exit conditions include hardcoded stop loss and take profit parameters, plus optional opposite-signal closing where the EA scans historical bars for reverse signals when both open and close permissions are enabled. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter which sets the trading volume ratio, supporting five money management modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. The EA uses an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are processed only once per bar, preventing duplicate entries, and employs a Recount flag to retry on data fetch failures. Signal timestamps are recorded for trade execution timing reference.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例或固定手数
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio or fixed lot size

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 资金管理模式：自由保证金/余额/扣亏自由保证金/扣亏余额/固定手数
parameters.description_en: Lot mode: free margin/balance/post-loss margin/post-loss balance/fixed lot

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许多仓反向平仓

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许空仓反向平仓

parameters.name: RISK
parameters.description: ASCtrend指标风险参数，影响信号灵敏度
parameters.description_en: ASCtrend risk parameter affecting signal sensitivity

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 信号K线索引，0为当前K线，1为前一根已收盘K线

pros: 使用IsNewBar机制确保每根K线只处理一次信号，避免重复开仓
提供五种资金管理模式，灵活适应不同风险偏好
支持独立控制开仓和平仓方向，可灵活组合多空策略
止损和止盈参数齐全，有基本的风险控制框架
Recount机制在数据获取失败时自动重试，增强鲁棒性
pros_en: Uses IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are processed only once per bar, preventing duplicate entries
Provides five money management modes for flexible risk preference adaptation
Supports independent control of open and close directions for flexible long/short strategy combinations
Stop loss and take profit parameters are complete with a basic risk control framework
Recount mechanism automatically retries on data fetch failures, enhancing robustness
cons: 依赖外部自定义指标ASCtrend，指标逻辑不透明，难以验证信号质量
历史K线扫描寻找平仓信号的循环没有上限保护，可能导致性能问题
没有点差过滤机制，在小时间周期或高滑点环境下可能不利
没有检查是否已存在同方向持仓，可能重复开仓
SignalBar=0时允许在未收盘K线上交易，信号可能频繁变化导致误判
cons_en: Depends on the external custom ASCtrend indicator with opaque logic, making signal quality hard to verify
The historical bar scanning loop for close signals has no upper bound protection, potentially causing performance issues
No spread filter mechanism, which may be disadvantageous on small timeframes or high-slip environments
No check for existing positions in the same direction, potentially causing duplicate entries
SignalBar=0 allows trading on unclosed bars where signals may fluctuate and cause misjudgment
improvements: 增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓
为历史K线扫描循环添加最大迭代次数限制，防止性能瓶颈
增加点差过滤和交易时间过滤，提高入场质量
improvements_en: Add position existence check logic to prevent duplicate entries in the same direction
Add a maximum iteration limit to the historical bar scanning loop to prevent performance bottlenecks
Add spread filter and trading session filter to improve entry quality

risk_points: 历史K线扫描循环无上限，极端情况下可能导致EA卡顿或超时
缺少同方向持仓检查，可能在趋势行情中连续加仓导致风险敞口过大
止损1000点/止盈2000点的默认值较大，在某些品种上可能不合适
risk_points_en: Historical bar scanning loop has no upper limit, which could cause EA lag or timeout in extreme cases
Lack of same-direction position check may lead to consecutive entries during trending markets, causing excessive risk exposure
Default SL 1000/TP 2000 points are large values that may not be suitable for all instruments
